title: Claim ownership of the WBTC, WETH and PAXG warp routes for governance
summary: Governance claims ownership (claim_ownership) of the three Hyperlane warp routers on Terra Classic for WBTC, WETH and PAXG (Ethereum <> Terra Classic), completing the two-step hpl_ownable handoff already approved for the mailbox, ISMs, hooks, IGP and the LUNC/USTC routes in proposal #12229. These are third-party assets, so their bridge contracts should belong to the community through governance, not to a single operator: after this proposal the ISM, hook and routes of these contracts can only be changed by a community vote. The owner has already proposed governance (terra10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700juxf95n) as next owner and moved the contract admin to governance. Nothing else changes. Contracts, verification steps and transactions: https://discourse.luncgoblins.com/t/claim-ownership-of-the-wbtc-weth-and-paxg-warp-routes-for-governance/606
